items.what: Ladd McConkey is questionable - latest (RotoWire, Nov 15): Ruled out for Monday's game - McConkey (back) won't travel to Baltimore with the Chargers for Monday's game against the Ravens and has been downgraded from questionable to out for Week 10 action. Check his status

Darren Waller is questionable - latest (ESPN, Nov 18): Waller didn't practice Wednesday due to a knee issue, and afterward head coach Dave Canales called the tight end's injury a "concern," Steve Reed of the Associated Press reports. Check his status
Jakobi Meyers is questionable - latest (RotoWire, Nov 15): Three grabs in Week 10 win - Meyers caught three of six targets for 34 yards in Sunday's 40-23 win over the Titans. Check his status
